info.name: User Management
info.description:
Every implemented endpoint of the User Management service, in an order that runs start to finish against an empty or populated database. Requests capture ids into collection variables, so a full run needs no manual input beyond base_url.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script, matching the contract's UUID v7 requirement.

Authentication (login, refresh, service tokens, JWKS) is not implemented yet — see the service's PROGRESS notes — so every request here identifies itself with the temporary X-User-Id header mock instead of a real JWT. Endpoints marked "service"-only in the contract (the /v1/internal/* group, and the currency/boost mutation endpoints) currently have no service-token auth wired up either, so they are called here without any special header.
